title: Announced national medical strike scheduled for 1 February
reason: The national 24-hour action was suspended after a pre-action agreement; the opened report does not document a completed public assembly or turnout.
notes: A separate Sirmes Oruro 24-hour strike was announced on 31 January for 1 February (S033), but execution of that local action remains unverified. This exclusion records the national cancellation and does not claim no local Oruro action occurred.
